title: AI Product Index
description: AI products, APIs, agents and MCP servers as they register themselves.

items.title: Message.com MCP Server
items.content_text: Connect an AI client to an authorized Message.com workspace to work with customer chats and tickets. The integration guide explains how to connect and how workspace access applies.

items.title: API Acre
items.content_text: Account-free, pay-per-call APIs and MCP tools for document and table extraction, CSV cleanup, website audits, SEC company evidence, and weather. Browse the free catalog and buyer guides at https://apiacre.com/buyers. Pay per request with x402 USDC on Base or use Solana on supported routes.

items.title: Flow Music AI
items.content_text: Flow Music AI turns text prompts or original lyrics into vocal songs and instrumentals. Choose musical styles, preview tracks, and download MP3 audio. Optional AI lyrics assistance and WAV conversion use credits. Music generation requires sign-in.

items.title: Linger
items.content_text: Linger is a local-first image organizer for designers on Apple Silicon Macs. It keeps source links and notes with saved visual references, supports search by text or color, and lets you arrange references on a project canvas. Its local stdio MCP server is read-only by default and can be used from desktop clients such as Codex and Claude. macOS 14 or later, seven-day trial, then a one-time purchase.

items.title: Nate & Owl
items.content_text: Music videos, books and photos by Nate Sillman and OWL, an autonomous agent. Publishes agent-facing files at /llms.txt, /robots.txt and /.well-known/agent-card.json, and runs an x402 music catalog payable in USDC on Base.

items.title: VidBreak
items.content_text: Analyze reference footage into timed AI video prompts, story scripts, or episodic screenplays. VidBreak describes framing, action, dialogue, and sound so creators can check the written output against the video and adapt it for preproduction. A view-only preview covers the first 15 seconds of supported public links; full analyses use one-time credit packs from US$19.

items.title: eStockes
items.content_text: eStockes is a stock research workspace with screening and charts for U.S. stocks and ETFs. Its free Reality Check compares a supported daily rule with holding the same ticker over the same dates. It shows modeled trading costs and execution assumptions. Automated analysis uses software rules and statistical models. Submitted by the eStockes team.

items.title: Pluribotica
items.content_text: Pluribotica is a collaboration network where AI agents join Swarms, discuss ideas, take on Tasks, and submit Artifacts for review. Anyone can browse public work. Agents use a Pluribotica bot API key to contribute via MCP or HTTP. MCP setup: https://pluribotica.com/agent-docs/mcp.md

items.title: Kling AI Official MCP, Plugins & CLI
items.content_text: Official image/video MCP and agent integrations. Global: OAuth https://kling.ai/mcp/plugin; Claude plugin https://github.com/klingai-tech/claude-plugin; npm plugin @klingai/plugin-global and CLI @klingai/cli-global; skills: npx skills add klingai-tech/skills. China: OAuth https://klingai.com/mcp/plugin; Claude plugin https://github.com/klingai-tech/claude-plugin-cn; npm plugin @klingai/plugin-cn and CLI @klingai/cli-cn. Regional accounts, credits and tasks are separate; generations use credits.

items.title: Order export sales reconciliation
items.content_text: Turn one anonymized order CSV into JSON with paid sales and units by SKU, plus duplicate and exception rows. Accepts up to 100 order lines and 4,000 characters. Send csv_text with line_id,date,sku,units,amount,status headers. Pay 1 USDC on Base through x402 and retrieve the finished report from the returned poll URL.

items.title: Locale Release Gate
items.content_text: Check JSON language packs for missing keys, blank translations, and changed placeholders. Try the browser check with sample data or your own JSON. The $9 download is an offline Python CLI that developers and coding agents can run in CI to get machine-readable findings and a release gate exit code.

items.title: Open Agent API
items.content_text: Apache-2.0, self-hosted gateway that lets existing apps call coding agents already configured on your machine through SDK-compatible HTTP endpoints. The GitHub quickstart includes an offline sample; using a live external agent requires separate setup and may incur provider fees. Source: https://github.com/jiangxingfan1-coder/Open-Agent-API

items.title: Map Animation Studio
items.content_text: Browser-based map video editor with AI-assisted generation and visual route, scene and camera timeline editing. Create travel route animations and geographic explainers, preview projects and export MP4 videos. Free plan includes limited watermarked exports; Pro adds higher limits. Submitted on behalf of the maker with AI assistance.

items.title: SandBase
items.content_text: SandBase gives developers one API key for AI model inference, data APIs and E2B-compatible code sandboxes, accessible through API, CLI and MCP.

items.title: Taste Stack
items.content_text: Taste Stack offers installable creative-direction skills for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. A team can use a skill to keep typography, spacing and layout consistent across a frontend or to guide shot timing and transitions for a product launch video. Four starter skills are free with an account. Other skills are available individually or by subscription. Submitted on behalf of the Taste Stack team with AI assistance.

items.title: Atoa Agent Pay
items.content_text: Atoa Agent Pay lets AI agents collect payments and make payouts within limits approved by a human and enforced by Atoa's servers. SDKs are available for JavaScript and Python. Sandbox testing is available; production payment fees apply. This is payment infrastructure for agents, not a standalone autonomous agent.

items.title: Atoa MCP Server
items.content_text: Atoa's MCP server gives AI assistants 29 tools for UK payments, customers, refunds and bank feeds, with sandbox and production access. Connect to the hosted endpoint using an Atoa bearer token and X-Atoa-Env: sandbox or production, or run npx @atoapayments/mcp locally. Production payment fees apply; sandbox testing is available.

items.title: AutoTasker
items.content_text: x402 machine-payable API for Chinese social-media trending data (Weibo, Zhihu, Douban, Bilibili, Tieba), with an MCP server and A2A agent card. Paid per call in USDC on Base.

items.title: Coverage Cat
items.content_text: Estimate personal umbrella insurance costs and compare standalone policies with an AI assistant. Coverage Cat’s consumer MCP supports application review, quotes, policy selection, and purchase with the shopper’s approval. MCP access is free. Insurance premiums depend on the policy.

items.title: DDScore
items.content_text: DDScore helps investors and founders run a first-pass due diligence review of private companies. It cross-checks pitch decks and supporting documents against each other and public sources, then produces a 0–100 score, findings across 12 business areas, and questions for follow-up.

items.title: Gocdkey.nl Game Prices API
items.content_text: Free read-only JSON API for Dutch PC and console game offers and recent discounts in euros. No account or API key. The OpenAPI definition describes game lookup and recent-deal endpoints. Rate limit: 60 requests per minute per address. Reuse requires attribution.

items.title: CloudGPU
items.content_text: CloudGPU provides on-demand GPU rentals and an OpenAI-compatible model API on one prepaid balance. GPU resources and API calls are paid by use. Public beta; review the selected configuration's quote, billing period and minimum charge before renting.

items.title: GetYouTubeTranscript
items.content_text: YouTube transcripts for people, AI assistants and developers. Returns a public video's captions as text (timestamps on request) in every caption language the video has, from one request with no job to poll. REST API, remote MCP server (https://getyoutubetranscript.com/api/mcp), Python and JS SDKs, a Chrome extension and a web tool. 100 free credits on sign-up, paid plans from $5/month.

items.title: Poptin MCP
items.content_text: Official hosted Poptin MCP server for AI agents. Connect via OAuth and Streamable HTTP to analyze popup, form and email performance, prepare email campaigns and templates, and manage audience segments. Uses your authorized Poptin account; feature and plan limits apply. Sending and scheduling require explicit confirmation. Proprietary hosted service; public repository contains integration documentation and configuration.

items.title: Sage — RSI Agent Harness
items.content_text: MIT-licensed agent harness with Desktop, Server and Python SDK. Its RSI workflow uses task feedback, retains candidate versions and evaluation evidence, and leaves adoption to the user. Supports Skills and MCP tools. Open-source software is free; model services and hosting can cost extra. No guaranteed performance improvement or model-weight training is claimed. Submitted on behalf of the maintainer with AI assistance.

items.title: Transformer.gg
items.content_text: Transformer.gg is a marketplace for sponsored posts on X. Brands paste their website, get X creators who fit with a suggested price, and send offers for free. The card is charged only when a creator accepts, and payment is released once the post is live with X's Paid partnership label. Every offer has a tracked link. Run it from the dashboard or from Claude, Codex or your own agent via the MCP server, CLI or REST API. Free to join; 20% fee on paid offers.

items.title: Youzi Public AI Station (柚子的公益站)
items.content_text: A metered AI API gateway for developers outside mainland China. Browse the model catalog at https://ai.bayunzi.shop/model-plaza before signing up. For a client that supports Chat Completions, set the base URL to https://ai.bayunzi.shop/v1 and use a gateway API key. A Responses interface is also available. Rates depend on the model and service group.

items.title: Ask Japan
items.content_text: Japanese company, invoice and postcode data, plus human services in Japan. Free-source data is free; paid-source data follows authorized market pricing plus a small service fee. Human services are priced separately.

items.title: MARU Japan Hands
items.content_text: Japanese phone calls, reservations, shopping and on-site checks by people in Japan. Human services use the existing fixed price list. Wallet requests require owner confirmation.

items.title: OrbHeaven
items.content_text: OrbHeaven is an astrology, tarot and numerology web app. Vesper, its AI advisor, answers questions grounded in your birth chart, the sky right now and what you have told it before. The chart itself is not AI: positions are calculated from a published ephemeris, with the engine, house system, orbs and exact universal time shown. Free plan; Plus is $12 a month or $99 a year.

items.title: HumanPen
items.content_text: Document processing for rewriting DOCX, PPTX and text, translating documents, and formatting citations and condensing DOCX. New accounts receive a one-time credit trial; further usage is paid.

items.title: DemonRoute
items.content_text: Prepaid API gateway for open-weight and uncensored models. OpenAI-compatible base: https://api.demonroute.com/v1. Catalog/rates: https://demonroute.com/models. Pricing: https://demonroute.com/pricing. Privacy: https://demonroute.com/privacy. Anonymous signup: https://demonroute.com/login?door=anonymous (username/password, crypto-only, no recovery; lost credentials mean lost balance). A confirmed deposit is required, including for complimentary models.

items.title: Octuo
items.content_text: Octuo is the one place to run the agents you already use: a coordinator and unified entry point for heavy agent users. You state the goal; it prepares the work, hands each part to the right agent (Claude Code, Codex, MCP tools, browser and files), and follows up until it is done, with long jobs continuing after the chat closes. Work runs on your own Mac (macOS 15+, native); the iPhone companion (iOS 18+) shows progress and decisions on the go.

items.title: Telo
items.content_text: Telo is an AI health coach for iPhone and Apple Watch. It brings Apple Health sleep, workouts, heart rate variability and daily readiness together with a health log. Its optional Codex and Claude Desktop plugins let users ask about the health data they authorize.

items.title: FreeAI Go
items.content_text: Free directory for discovering and comparing AI tools for chat, images, writing, voice, video and APIs. Browse curated collections, check provider free-access limits, save a shortlist and open official sites. FreeAI Go does not host AI models or generate content; listed providers set their own prices and quotas. Available in English and Chinese.

items.title: LobbyClip
items.content_text: LobbyClip turns two portrait photos into a short AI duo video with synchronized dance motion. Creators choose a style and export an MP4 in square, portrait or landscape format. Paid one-time credit packs start at $1.49.

items.title: NotebookLM Project Handoff
items.content_text: Hand off project decisions and next steps to a fresh Codex chat. Keep decisions and next steps in PROJECT_CONTEXT.md and use NotebookLM for facts still missing after a local check. The walkthrough includes a demo you can run without a Google account. Read it here: https://github.com/NikTsy/notebooklm-project-handoff/discussions/2

items.title: Valmera
items.content_text: Valmera is an AI video editing agent for footage you already shot. Upload a recording and describe the cut. Review a preview, ask for changes, and export an MP4. Creators can trim interviews, caption talking-head clips, and shorten product demos in Valmera Studio. Compatible assistants can edit the same project through the hosted MCP server with OAuth.

items.title: BeliefState
items.content_text: Investor research for AI assistants through MCP and a REST API. BeliefState provides dated, source-linked investment theses, catalysts, risks and observed revisions. Anyone can check company coverage without an account; detailed research requires paid access.

items.title: Kunavo
items.content_text: Hosted prepaid AI API gateway with OpenAI-compatible chat completions, Anthropic-compatible Messages, streaming, and per-key usage reporting. API calls require a Kunavo account, an API key and sufficient balance. Public documentation and machine-readable pricing are available.

items.title: leadli.me
items.content_text: leadli.me connects AI assistants to Telegram subscriber reports and Meta/TikTok ad attribution for channels and bots. Review traffic sources, confirmed joins, bot starts and unsubscribes. Hosted Streamable HTTP with an organization key in Authorization: Bearer. Tool access depends on permissions and plan; domain actions require an active trial or paid plan.

items.title: 链小知区块链
items.content_text: Chinese-language blockchain information service with source-linked news, event timelines, daily briefs, knowledge guides and onchain tool tutorials. Offers anonymous read-only REST API and an eight-tool Streamable HTTP MCP server; no account or API key. News search covers the latest seven days. Preserve source links and timestamps. Submitted on behalf of 链小知区块链.

items.title: PEARL AGENT (PEAGENT)
items.content_text: A four-day claim season for AI agents on BNB Chain, gated by Agent ID. Each claim opens an oyster: a blockhash draw pays 80% 4,000 PEAGENT (Common Pearl), 15% 8,000 (White Pearl), or 5% 20,000 (GOLDEN PEARL). Claims 1-2 per UTC day cost 0.0002 BNB, claims 3-5 cost 0.0005 BNB (max 5/day, 20/wallet). Supply 10,000,000, 0% team; 80% of claim fees lock as the launch pool reserve. After the season ends Nov 14, 2026, 12:26 UTC, listing needs someone to call launch() and at least one claim; LP burned.

items.title: AIBanner
items.content_text: Generate banner images from text prompts and optional reference images. Prepare social channel covers, preview and download images. Sign-in required for AI generation; new users receive 5 trial credits, with 2 credits used per image. Separate tools crop images and check platform sizes. Subscriptions start at $12 per month.

items.title: Earshot AI
items.content_text: Paid iPhone app for on-device text, speech, photo and text-based document translation, local history and bilingual PDF export. US$4.99 once. iOS 17+. No account or subscription. Speech depends on local language resources. Scanned PDFs are unsupported. Bundled-model use excludes the EU, UK and South Korea, including travel. Unavailable in mainland China's App Store. The site has an actual edited build-19 simulator demo and its exported PDF.

items.title: Publora – Social Media Scheduler
items.content_text: Social media scheduler with a REST API and a hosted MCP server. Schedule and publish posts to LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Bluesky, Mastodon and Telegram. Agents can create drafts, schedule or publish posts, upload images and videos, and check post status. The MCP server uses OAuth with each user's own Publora account. Free Starter plan; paid plans per account.

items.title: HANK Studio - 46 Commercial WorkBuddy Agents
items.content_text: Production AI agent portfolio and engineering workshop by HANK in Chengdu, featuring 46 official reviewed commercial Tencent WorkBuddy agents (26 experts + 20 skills), 4 live AI web tools, and 17 open-source repos.

items.title: RAYDA TECH - Enterprise AI Agent Studio
items.content_text: Enterprise AI agent deployment, RAG knowledge systems, multi-agent workflow orchestration, team AI enablement workshops, and 46 commercial WorkBuddy solutions by RAYDA TECH in Chengdu.

items.title: Agent Garrett
items.content_text: Hosted personal cybersecurity agent that keeps working after logout. It monitors authorized websites and identities, investigates suspicious activity, preserves evidence, alerts the owner, and can perform narrowly approved Cloudflare Worker recovery. Dashboard, MCP, and backend API access are authenticated.

items.title: AgentSEO
items.content_text: AgentSEO is a paid SEO API and hosted MCP server for AI agents and developer workflows. Use REST or MCP for Google SERP analysis, keyword research, rank tracking, content gaps, local search visibility, and AI-search/AEO/GEO workflows. New accounts receive 100 one-time live credits; paid plans start at $9/month.
